title: BookReader Pro
tagline: Advanced native Android eBook & document reader featuring real-time neural TTS, custom typography engine, and seamless offline storage
hero_description: A feature-rich, high-performance native Android reading application crafted with Jetpack Compose. Engineered for avid readers, researchers, and students, BookReader Pro delivers instant document rendering, background neural text-to-speech, and responsive full-screen reading immersion.

features.rendering: Instant Document Rendering: High-performance pagination with PDF and EPUB rendering engine.
features.tts: Neural Text-to-Speech: Background audio playback with variable speeds and word highlighting.
features.typography: Customizable Reading Experience: Fine-tuned line heights, margins, font sizes, and dark/sepia reading themes.
features.library: Offline Library Management: Smart shelf organization, progress synchronization, and bookmarks.
